title: City of Dragons!
text:
Not only did our ten year old enjoy this tour with Barbara, but so did the rest of our family!  We were a group of six, mom, dad, aunt, uncle, grandma (that uses a walker), and were delighted to learn and search for the the dragons of Barcelona as well as take in the sights of the city.  The flow was perfect, and perfect for all of us...not too fast paced, never boring,and sprinked with activity!
There was a great mix of history, lore, active participation, and even some yummy treats!

title: My family were in Barcelona for 4...
text: My family were in Barcelona for 4 days. We did the Dragon tour on our first day in Barcelona and it was the best introduction of the city we could have had. Our knowledgeable guide and her partner big stunning head showed us the city center in a very very entertaining way. We saw details of the city that we could not have seen without a local next to us. We visited little stores that kidswere mad with it and we even tasted local sweets Kids and grandma loved it!.
